tasks.short: Maintain cage security under actual rules

steps.what: Check actual cage-access authorisation and required identity against the existing access-control rules
inputs: actual existing access authorisation and cage rules

steps.what: Observe actual cage conditions and people while maintaining the required secure working position and attention
outputs: cashier's actual security awareness and secure presence

steps.what: Maintain actual physical cage safeguards and follow secure handling rules during ordinary cage work
inputs: cashier's actual security awareness and secure presence
actual cage barriers and handling rules

tasks.design: Keep actual access checking, observation and physical cage safeguards with the cashier. {OTHER}, the existing cage access-control application, already supplies the authorisation view; a new template or dashboard does not remove the actual identity check or secure presence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Security depends on actual people, physical safeguards and attention.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific new configuration changes the existing access check or physical work.
tasks.still_hard: An authorised credential does not establish that the person using it is authorised.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an actual security irregularity and follow the existing response rules.

ambition.what: No change in access authority or unattended security.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no system change or new monitoring

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: routine cage security combines actual identity checks, observation and physical safeguards that an existing access view does not replace.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional routine cage security without an incident, not an invented incident-report baseline.
Security administrators maintain actual access authorisation in the access-control application; cashier identity checking is fully retained in s1. No new identity feed or camera inference is assumed.

Native views/templates were considered. The actual lookup is split and retained; this ordinary episode has no incident record, report or discrete send. Any real incident needs its actual separate response and record work.
All actual steps remain unchanged. Gross/net saving and incremental upkeep are zero because no system change is proposed.
unknowns: Any actual repeated access-record entry beyond existing controls
research_questions: Does the actual site have a separate recurring cage record or incident workflow needing its own assessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unchanged routine security; the actual authorisation lookup is separately counted and no incident report is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Reconcile transaction summaries and balance books

steps.what: Obtain actual daily cage transaction summaries and corresponding book/control totals for the correct period
inputs: actual book/control totals and reporting period

steps.what: Match the checked cage summaries against book totals using exact period, reference, currency and amount rules; flag duplicate or unmatched records
Inspect match completeness and unmatched or duplicate records, investigate actual differences against transaction evidence and determine justified corrections or unresolved variances
outputs: cashier's supported corrections and unresolved variances

steps.what: Complete and check the actual reconciliation record and permitted correction entries against evidence
inputs: cashier's supported corrections and unresolved variances
outputs: complete checked reconciliation and permitted correction entries

steps.what: Commit the completed checked reconciliation and correction entries within actual cashier authority
inputs: complete checked reconciliation and permitted correction entries
outputs: saved daily reconciliation and authorised corrections

tasks.design: Configure native exact-rule matching between {OTHER}, the cage transaction/reconciliation application, and {ERP}; s2 produces matched and exception rows from the cashier-checked source set. The cashier checks completeness, investigates exceptions and completes/checks permitted correction entries before the separate commit; existing equivalent matching earns no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and variance filtering can interrupt daily reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference/period views can expose actual matching and difference evidence.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent balance may conceal misclassification or an unsupported correction.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve an unresolved variance instead of forcing the books to balance.

ambition.what: No automatic write-off or expanded correction authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for cage/ledger access and staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native transaction-reference and variance views can reduce reconciliation handling while difference investigation and corrections require human validation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human reconciliation effort, not a measured cash-up baseline.
Cage systems produce actual transaction IDs, period, type and amounts; finance maintains actual book/control records. The cashier checks completeness in s1 and investigates unmatched records in s3.

Configure native exact matching only where comparisons are currently manual. The checked sources must expose actual period, reference, currency and amounts; missing keys, duplicates or incompatible totals become exceptions in s2, with manual checking in s3. Existing totals are already computed today and earn no saving. No new discrepancy code is assumed.

Provisional shares 20/30/30/19/1 are unmeasured. Native source navigation saves 2 and exact-rule matching saves 30, for gross 32; 1.5 hours of rule/view upkeep leaves 30.5 net. The negligible final commit is fully retained. Equivalent existing matching removes that opportunity.
Only corrections within real cashier authority are committed; others remain unresolved for existing authorisation. Final payload is checked in s4 and edits void the gate.
unknowns: Existing reconciliation views and actual correction authority
research_questions: Do native reference/variance views remove repeated handling after full investigation and checking?

already_counted.description: Inspect sources/matches and investigate actual differences

approvals.approved_version: complete checked reconciliation and permitted correction entries

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 30.5%; conditional on actual manual rule comparisons, with all source capture, exceptions and correction decisions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain customer signatures on qualifying winnings receipts

steps.what: Find the actual winnings receipt and verify the event requiring a customer signature
inputs: actual winnings event and receipt identity

steps.what: Check the actual customer and receipt identity before requesting the required signature
Present the actual receipt, explain the signature requirement and witness the customer's actual signing
Check the actual signed receipt and enter its correct winnings-event association in the cage receipt record
Save the completed checked signed-receipt record association
outputs: saved actual signed winnings receipt record

tasks.design: Configure native event-to-receipt lookup in {OTHER}, the cage receipt application. The cashier verifies identity, obtains the actual customer signature and separately checks/records the signed receipt before saving; no signature, identity or payout authorisation is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated receipt navigation can interrupt obtaining a required signature.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event/receipt links can expose the actual transaction record.
tasks.still_hard: The receipt must belong to the actual customer and transaction.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a mismatch before asking a customer to sign.

ambition.what: No change in payout or identity authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for cage receipt access and actual signature-handling approval

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native receipt lookup can reduce navigation while actual identity and signature checks remain cashier work.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional cashier handling of an actual qualifying receipt, not a new payout baseline or a claimed national rule.
The cage transaction system supplies actual winnings/event/receipt identity; the cashier checks customer identity and witnesses actual signing. Association entry/capture remains fully counted in s4.
Only receipt navigation changes; equivalent current links remove the gain. No free structured signature-validation feed is assumed.
Gross provisional saving 2 minus 0.5 hour of receipt-link upkeep gives 1.5 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
All shares are cashier labour, including actual assistance while signing; the customer's own effort is not counted as a saving.
unknowns: Actual qualifying receipt procedure and current lookup
research_questions: Does native receipt linking remove repeated cashier navigation without weakening identity checks?

already_counted.description: Read actual receipt/event and check signed record association

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.5%; identity, signature assistance and receipt capture remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Accept credit applications and verify references for authorisation

steps.what: Accept the actual customer's credit application and clarify missing applicant information
outputs: actual clarified customer application and remaining gaps

steps.what: Enter and check actual application identity, reference details and requested credit/check-cashing facility
inputs: actual clarified customer application and remaining gaps
existing actual customer record where present
outputs: cashier-checked application fields and reference contacts

steps.what: Verify actual credit references through the approved reference-check procedure and inspect contradictory or missing evidence
inputs: cashier-checked application fields and reference contacts
actual approved verification authority and reference responses

steps.what: Determine permitted check-cashing/house-credit authorisation and complete the checked application/reference record within actual delegated limits
inputs: cashier-checked application fields and reference contacts
actual delegated authority and authorisation criteria
outputs: complete checked application/reference record and permitted authorisation

steps.what: Commit the completed checked application/reference record and permitted authorisation in the cage credit system
inputs: complete checked application/reference record and permitted authorisation
outputs: saved credit/check-cashing application and actual permitted authorisation

tasks.design: Configure native existing-customer field reuse in {OTHER}, the cage credit/application system. The cashier accepts the real application, verifies references and completes/checks the actual record and permitted authorisation before committing; no model scores creditworthiness or grants a facility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing customer identity can be repeatedly entered into an actual application.
tasks.enabler_now: Native customer-field reuse can reduce fixed identity entry.
tasks.still_hard: Reference authenticity, contradictions and credit authority require actual verification.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a complete application does not establish a trustworthy reference.

ambition.what: No automatic credit decision or expanded authorisation limit.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for application/reference permissions and responsible credit-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native customer-field reuse can reduce application entry while actual reference verification and credit authority remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional actual application work with existing customer identity, not a measured credit-processing baseline.

Customers supply actual application/reference information; existing cage records supply actual customer identity. Clarification and capture remain counted in s1/s2, verification responses and meaning remain counted in s3/s4.
Only fixed existing-customer fields change. New applicants and missing fields remain manual; equivalent current reuse removes the gain. No structured verified-reference result is assumed free.
Gross provisional saving 1.9 minus 0.5 hour of customer-field upkeep gives 1.4 net. Same-system commit is negligible and fully retained.

s4 binds the actual final record and real delegated decision; requests beyond authority remain pending for existing authorised review. No discrete external reference request, customer notice or payment is automated or promised.
unknowns: Actual verification procedure and delegated authority
research_questions: Does customer-field reuse save real application entry after clarification and full reference checks?

already_counted.description: Enter/check application and verify/resolve actual reference evidence

approvals.approved_version: complete checked application/reference record and permitted authorisation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.4%; actual application clarification, verification and decision remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Respect real credit and disclosure authority
